bugs.text: Challenging-stage wave and PERFECT bonuses never trigger and NUMBER OF HITS is wrong: shooting a challenge enemy does not increment chWaveHits/chHits (only ramming at 888 does).
The ship is not drawn while being pulled up by the tractor beam (drawPlayer returns when p.captured), so capture looks like the ship vanishing and reappearing red on the boss.
Title score table lists Zako as 50/50 instead of 50/100.
Results screen values overlap the centred labels (seen in screenshot 4-play-015s).
Entry paths end at the fixed slot but formation slots sway up to 18 px, so an arriving enemy visibly snaps sideways; reentry/return paths (665, 695) have the same snap.

Formation enemies fire constantly (per-enemy 3%/frame once timer lapses, cap 5 bullets) so there are nearly always 5 enemy shots on screen; the play-test lost all lives within ~15 s of play. Much harsher than the arcade, where formation enemies do not fire.

In gameover/results and in challenge mode a dead player ship is still drawn at its last position (only mode 'play' hides it); in challenge mode READY is also never shown (1034) and a dead player can still fire (878).
All stage badges use one identical flag sprite regardless of denomination, and stage 1 shows no badge.
Ramming an enemy counts as a hit with no shot fired, so the hit ratio can exceed 100%; a ram on an undamaged boss kills it outright but awards no points (527-528).
Dual fighter can have 3 shots on screen (fires a pair when one shot remains).
Enemy-body collision for the dual fighter tests only the centre point, so the outer halves cannot be rammed.
Challenge result screen duration is counted in render frames, so it depends on refresh rate.

summary: A compact, well-organised file: state, update and render are cleanly split, paths are proper Catmull-Rom polylines with arc-length lookup, the formation sways and breathes, groups stream in along curves, bosses take two hits and change colour, dive with escorts, stop to project an animated widening beam, capture the fighter, and the rescue/dual-fighter and hostile-captive branches are all wired up and reachable. The play-test confirms it loads clean and the screenshots show entry streams, a live beam, a captive on a damaged boss, and the results screen. It loses fidelity in the details: the captured ship disappears instead of being pulled up red, challenge-stage bonuses can never be earned because shot hits are not counted, the score table has a typo, results text overlaps, badges are all one sprite, enemies snap sideways when they join the swaying formation, and formation enemies fire far more than the arcade so early stages are punishing. Some dead code (two unused death/capture functions, a placeholder call) suggests a hasty final pass, but overall it looks and moves like Galaga.
